release_scope: User-approved completion of batches 1–3; not completion of all 77 actionable recommendations.
baseline_provenance: Values from the earlier delivered Phase 1 audit/session record, not remeasured in this batch. Original report files are absent from the restored filesystem.
measurement_method: 15 final local production runs; fresh Chromium profile per run, warm local server, simulated throttling. Three-run medians per case. Same Lighthouse version and stated device/network/CPU presets as the earlier audit, not a controlled same-time hardware comparison.
limitations: Sandbox/software-rendered lab results, not deployed or physical-device measurements.
Historical raw baseline reports are not in this restored filesystem.
Performance remains low; product/payment TBT medians worsened. No across-the-board performance or field-INP improvement is claimed.
